title: ADDRESS EIB read after a READQ TD QIDERR, ADDRESS COMMAREA written through, and ADDRESS COMMAREA in a task with no COMMAREA (the null value, not an error)

scenarios.summary: ADDRESS EIB and a view of the EIB, then READQ TD of an undefined queue with RESP: the view read afterwards holds EIBRESP 44 (QIDERR), equal to DFHEIBLK's EIBRESP and to the RESP value
LINK with COMMAREA(WS-AREA) LENGTH(20): the callee reads EIBCALEN 20 through its EIB view and writes through its ADDRESS COMMAREA view into the caller's area
a terminal task has no COMMAREA: ADDRESS COMMAREA gives the null value X'FF000000' and the EIB view's EIBCALEN is 0; nothing is refused
